user.title: Set up Concierge MCP
user.description: This creates a second, independently-scoped MCP endpoint at `/api/concierge_mcp`, authenticated by its own secret. It cannot be used to reach any other Home Assistant API. You will choose which entities it exposes after setup, from the integration's options.

show_secret.title: Your guest secret
show_secret.description:
Give this secret to your MCP client. It is shown only once — if you lose it, generate a new one from the integration's options page.

```
{secret}
```

abort.single_instance_allowed: Concierge MCP is already configured. Only one instance is supported.

entities.title: Exposed entities
entities.description: Choose exactly which entities the guest chatbot can see. Anything not listed here is invisible to it, even if it exists elsewhere in Home Assistant.

data.control: Entities allowed to be controlled (reserved for a future release; has no effect yet)

regenerate_secret.title: Regenerate guest secret
regenerate_secret.description:
This immediately invalidates the old secret. Update your MCP client before confirming, or it will lose access.

```
{secret}
```

cloudflare_access.title: Cloudflare Access sign-in (optional)
cloudflare_access.description: Lets you (a human, signed in through Cloudflare Access) use this endpoint directly — for example to add it to Claude.ai for testing — separately from the guest secret used by your chatbot backend. Leave either field blank to disable this and accept only the guest secret.

data.cf_access_team_domain: Cloudflare Access team domain (e.g. myteam, without .cloudflareaccess.com)
